# Earthquake catalogues through any FDSN event web service

`fdsn_catalog` · adapter 1.0.0 · makes `seismic_catalog` tokens

| | |
|---|---|
| Provider | The agency the region names (USGS ANSS ComCat, GeoNet, EMSC, …) |
| Home | https://www.fdsn.org/webservices/ |
| Licence | `LicenseRef-per-region` |

## Terms

Each region's YAML names its service, its provider and the provider's licence; every token carries that licence. USGS ComCat is public domain; GeoNet and EMSC publish under CC BY 4.0 (cite them).

## Cite

- U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program (2017). Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) Comprehensive Catalog of Earthquake Events and Products. https://doi.org/10.5066/F7MS3QZH
- GeoNet: GNS Science (1970). New Zealand Earthquake Catalogue. https://doi.org/10.21420/0S8P-TZ38
- Euro-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC), https://www.seismicportal.eu

## Access

FDSN event service named in `sources.fdsn_catalog.service`, `format=text`, one request per calendar month inside the region's box, from the region's `min_magnitude`. A month the service calls too big (HTTP 400 or 413) is fetched in halves and joined under one header. At most one request per second; every month is downloaded once and cached by hash.

## From the source to the token

| Token slot | Comes from |
|---|---|
| `kind` | `event` |
| `lat, lon` | Latitude, Longitude |
| `depth_km` | Depth/km (below sea level; under 0.11 km from the ellipsoid) |
| `time` | Time, UTC |
| `value` | Magnitude |
| `qualifiers` | magnitude_type ← MagType through `MAGNITUDE_ALIASES`, event_id ← EventID, event_type ← EventType when the service gives one |
| `provenance.record` | `eventid=<EventID>;author=<Author>;magtype=<MagType>` |
| `provenance.content_hash` | sha256 of the month's raw file |

## Uncertainty

The text format carries no errors. Magnitude 1σ is assumed: 0.1 for Mw, 0.2 for ML, 0.3 otherwise (`uncertainty_basis: assumed`); resolution an assumed 1 km and 0.1 s.

## Known issues

- Magnitude types are mixed and differ by agency and decade (ML, Md, mb, Mw flavours). Every token carries its type; nothing converts between them.
- ComCat's text format has no event type column: the region asks the service for `eventtype=earthquake` instead.
- Completeness differs by region and decade; each region states the magnitude it trusts (`completeness`) and the health report estimates it per year.
- Agencies revise recent months. A refresh brings new bytes, a new hash and new tokens; the old version stays in the raw store.
- An event on a month boundary can come back twice; the second is dropped.
